title: Parking Management System
description: Object-oriented console app for a 50-slot parking lot. Staff and admin logins, check-in and check-out, hourly billing, search, history and revenue, saved in binary .dat files.

title: Bus Ticket System
description: Console booking system with a password-protected admin menu to add, view and update buses, plus passenger bookings with seat numbers and payment status.

title: PDRoute Dispatch (Spiral 1)
description: Terminal shell for package routing. It registers packages with validated input, three priority levels and a 500 kg vehicle limit, and prints an aligned queue table. Later modules are still planned.

title: Hotel Management System
description: Console booking system with masked password-protected admin menu to register, order with date validation, and generating automated check-out bills.
